note: Copilot & AI #13. The demo copy lives in C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools (short path, no Windows user name) with a baseline git commit so the agent's changes show in git diff; acceptance\reference-solution.patch is removed from the copy so the agent cannot read it. Permission level stays Manual: never use Allow all. Confirm the owner's Copilot plan on the day (Copilot Free allowance may run out during the take). Record the real agent result: if it breaks a rule or fails the acceptance test, keep the take and rewrite the narration. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools)) { Copy-Item .\src\contoso-vendor-tools C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools -Recurse; Remove-Item C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools\acceptance\reference-solution.patch -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools -Recurse -Directory -Filter __pycache__ | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force; Push-Location C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools; git init -b main | Out-Null; Add-Content .git/info/exclude '__pycache__/'; Add-Content .git/info/exclude '.pytest_cache/'; git add .; git -c user.name='MG Lab' -c user.email='lab@example.invalid' commit -q -m baseline; Pop-Location }
Push-Location C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools; python -m pytest -q; python -m pytest acceptance -q; Pop-Location
Push-Location src; python -m customcheck check C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools; Pop-Location

# manual (owner): open C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools in VS Code and trust the workspace; Copilot icon in the Status Bar, Use AI Features, sign in with the owner's GitHub account off camera; confirm the plan and note whether Session Target offers Copilot and Local
# manual (owner): run the task once off camera to learn the run length, then reset the demo copy with git checkout . ; git clean -fd

screens.name: harness
steps: Open the folder C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools; Chat view, new chat, Session Target set to Copilot
Open the agent picker: show Ask, Agent, Plan and the custom agent Renewal reviewer
Command Palette, Chat: Open Customizations, Instructions: show copilot-instructions.md, python-tests and cli listed
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

screens.name: agent-run
steps: New chat, Agent selected, Session Target Copilot, permission level Manual
Prompt exactly: Show the notice deadline (renewal date minus notice_days) for each vendor in the renewals report, and flag vendors whose deadline has already passed.
Record the real run: files it opens, edits to renewals.py and cli.py, tests it adds, python -m pytest in the terminal, and approve each permission prompt on camera
At the end open the final answer with the References section expanded so the instruction files are visible
Do not retake to make it look better; if the agent ignores a rule keep that take
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)
any path that shows the Windows user name

screens.name: acceptance
screens.note: Runs in the demo copy C:\demo\contoso-vendor-tools. Record the real verdict, pass or fail.

screens.name: prompt-local
steps: In a new Session Target Copilot chat type / and record which entries appear (the skill renewal-report should; record whether renewal-report-prompt does)
If the Local harness is still offered: new chat with Session Target Local, type / and show the prompt file
Command Palette, Chat: Open Customizations, Migrations: show the Convert Prompt to Skills section
If Local is gone say so and record only the Copilot chat and the Migrations tab (and put the narration about February 2027 in the past tense)
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

teardown: # manual (owner): close and archive the chat sessions (Manage Sessions); restore the Copilot plan if it was changed for the recording
needs: licence:github-copilot (owner's plan, confirm on the day)
